jobs.description:
**About Polance**

Polance is an outsourcing company working with international clients and a distributed network of software engineers across Europe and Asia.

We are expanding our engineering partner network and looking to establish long-term professional relationships with experienced software engineers interested in accessing US market opportunities and collaborating on international software projects.

Our approach combines opportunity sourcing, technical expertise, client relationships, and engineering delivery resources to create sustainable project-based partnerships.

**About the Partnership**

We are looking for experienced software engineers who want to build a long-term collaboration with Polance.

Rather than working independently on every aspect of finding and managing projects, partners can benefit from our recruitment operations, opportunity sourcing, interview preparation, engineering resources, and project coordination.

Depending on the engagement and client requirements, partners may participate in client-facing activities while Polance provides additional engineering resources to support project execution.

This is an opportunity to build an ongoing professional relationship rather than a one-time freelance engagement.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Technical Lead, Apple Card & Savings
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
The Apple Card & Savings team is building the financial products that put users in control of their money. We built Apple Card to reinvent how credit cards work, and we continue to launch groundbreaking features used by millions of people every day. We are looking for a technical lead who craves the challenge of architecting mission-critical systems at scale, sets technical direction across teams, and is equally at home in a design review, a production incident, or a technical negotiation with a financial partner.
  
  
Description
  
  
You'll lead the architecture and evolution of the distributed services that power Apple Card and Savings, while staying hands-on in code and operations. You'll be given the flexibility to drive creative solutions, the support of a talented and driven team, and the autonomy and responsibility to take full ownership of critical systems. Our team operates as DevOps: we build what we run. You'll shape the architecture of our platform through deep experience operating, monitoring, and supporting it on call, and you'll set the bar for how we ship and run software — safe, progressive releases, clear service level objectives, and automation over manual toil. You'll lead large, multi-quarter efforts — including complex integrations with financial institution and payment network partners and other Apple services — from conception through production, with reliability and customer trust as non-negotiables. As a technical leader, you'll drive technical discussions across teams and organizations, write specifications, represent Apple in technical discussions with external partners, review code and designs, mentor senior engineers, and raise the engineering bar for the team. Success in this role requires strong self-motivation, crisp and clear communication, a highly collaborative approach, and the ability to define and influence engineering strategy well beyond your own team.

jobs.description:

We are building a new billing platform from the ground up and need the senior engineer who owns its core: the engine that moves claims and payments through their lifecycles, the background job system that runs every automated step, and the integrations with payers, clearinghouses and banks. Backend engineering on a money system, TypeScript on PostgreSQL on Azure, working directly with the CTO on a team that stays at two to four engineers.

The type of engineer we are seeking:

A backend engineer who has shipped a transactional system (payments, claims, orders, ledgers, anything where a row posting twice is a real problem) in a typed language, and who has been the one who found out when it broke.

* Seven or more years of backend engineering in production, in a typed language: TypeScript or Node.js, C#, Java, Go or Kotlin. TypeScript is what we use. A strong C# or Java engineer who has not written much TypeScript is fine; a Python-only engineer is not.
* A relational database as their primary store for years. PostgreSQL preferred; SQL Server, DB2, Oracle or MySQL fine. They should be able to talk about transactions, locking and a deadlock they debugged.
* Built and ran something with background workers, queues and retries. The tool does not matter (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS, Azure Service Bus, Hangfire, Quartz, Sidekiq, Celery, a database table). The years running it do.

jobs.title: Software Developer AI
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

As a Software Developer, you’ll build and improve applications that help users and teams work effectively. You’ll contribute across the software development lifecycle, from system design and web development to testing and deployment. You’ll collaborate in an Agile software development environment, apply sound software engineering practices, and help create scalable systems.

**Duties**

* Develop, test, and maintain applications using appropriate programming languages, frameworks, and software design patterns.
* Design and integrate REST (Representational State Transfer) and RESTful APIs (application programming interfaces), microservices, and SQL-backed data solutions.
* Contribute to front-end development and web development using JavaScript and relevant JavaScript frameworks.
* Support cloud infrastructure, IT infrastructure, and CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery) workflows; use version control to coordinate changes.
* Your impact: Reliable, well-designed applications help users complete tasks efficiently and give teams a stronger foundation for future development.

**Requirements**

* Experience with software development, application development, software design, system design for system development, and Agile practices.
* Familiarity with scalable systems, scalability, APIs, REST, design patterns, and version control tools such as Git or GitHub.
* Relevant technologies may include Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, React Express, Java, Python, C, C++,.NET, VBA, Linux, MySQL, and SQL.
* Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, microservices, CI/CD, and role-based access control (RBAC) is useful.
* Quantum engineering knowledge is a nice-to-have; not every listed technology is required.

Pay: $15.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
